title: Self-organization reads as optimal Bayesian design

statements.text: Read teleologically, the principle gives an optimality account of self-organization: things behave as if maximizing the marginal likelihood (Bayesian model evidence) of their own model.

sources.quote: Teleologically, the free energy principle offers a normative account of self-organisation in terms of optimal Bayesian design and decision-making, in the sense of maximising marginal likelihood or Bayesian model evidence.
